lead_headline: Ohio votes put three Amazon data-centre plans at risk
facebook_post:
Ohio votes put three Amazon data-centre plans at risk

Ohio voters have backed 21 local measures affecting data-centre plans. The Financial Times identifies three proposed Amazon projects at risk of delays or cancellation — not confirmed cancellations.

Today's Sapiver Forge Daily Brief also examines model distillation, Windows diagnostics and the Microsoft 365 outage.
